items.title: Abimelech son of Gideon
items.charge: Murder of seventy brothers on one stone; usurping a crown

items.title: Absalom
items.charge: Murder of Amnon; conspiracy and rebellion against the king his father; lying with his father's concubines

items.title: Adonijah
items.charge: Exalting himself to be king; asking for the king's concubine

items.title: Ahab
items.charge: Marrying Jezebel; serving Baal; sparing Ben-hadad whom the Lord appointed to destruction

items.title: Ahaz
items.charge: Burning his children in the fire; copying the altar of Damascus; sacrificing to the gods that smote him

items.title: Ahaziah of Israel
items.charge: Inquiring of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron

items.title: Ahaziah of Judah
items.charge: Walking in the ways of the house of Ahab, his mother being his counsellor to do wickedly

items.title: Amaziah
items.charge: Bringing home the gods of Seir and bowing to them

items.title: Amnon
items.charge: Rape of his sister Tamar

items.title: Amon
items.charge: Serving his father's idols and refusing his father's repentance

items.title: Antiochus Epiphanes
items.charge: Defiling the temple; forbidding the law; murdering the faithful

items.title: Asa in his first years
items.charge: Taking away the strange altars and the high places; commanding Judah to seek the Lord and do the law; crying to the Lord against a million Ethiopians

items.title: Asa in his latter years
items.charge: Hiring the king of Syria against Israel; imprisoning the seer who reproved him; seeking to the physicians and not to the Lord

items.title: Athaliah
items.charge: Destroying the seed royal of Judah; usurping the throne

items.title: Baanah and Rechab
items.charge: Murder of Ish-bosheth in his bed

items.title: Baasha
items.charge: Walking in the way of Jeroboam after being raised up to destroy Jeroboam's house

items.title: Barzillai the Gileadite
items.charge: Bringing beds, wheat, and honey to the king and his hungry men in the wilderness at Mahanaim

items.title: Belshazzar
items.charge: Drinking from the temple vessels and praising the gods of gold and silver

items.title: Bigthan and Teresh
items.charge: Conspiring to lay hands on king Ahasuerus

items.title: David
items.charge: A man after the Lord's own heart; keeping his commandments and following him with all his heart, save only in the matter of Uriah

items.title: David and Bathsheba
items.charge: Adultery and the arranged death of Uriah

items.title: David's numbering of the people
items.charge: Numbering Israel in pride; a plague on the nation

items.title: Herod Agrippa
items.charge: Accepting worship due to God alone

items.title: Herod the Great and the children of Bethlehem
items.charge: Slaying all the male children of Bethlehem from two years old and under

items.title: Hezekiah
items.charge: Trusting in the Lord God of Israel; cleaving to him and keeping his commandments; breaking the brasen serpent; keeping the passover; spreading Sennacherib's letter before the Lord

items.title: Hezekiah and the ambassadors of Babylon
items.charge: Showing all his treasures to Babylon in the pride of his heart

items.title: Israel asking for a king
items.charge: Rejecting the Lord's rule to be like the nations

items.title: Jehoahaz (Shallum) of Judah
items.charge: Doing evil in the sight of the Lord according to all that his fathers had done

items.title: Jehoiachin (Coniah)
items.charge: Doing evil as his father Jehoiakim had done; a signet plucked from the Lord's right hand

items.title: Jehoiada the priest
items.charge: Hiding the king's son six years from Athaliah; making a covenant between the Lord, the king, and the people; doing good in Israel, both toward God and toward his house

items.title: Jehoiakim
items.charge: Building with unrighteousness; shedding innocent blood; burning the scroll of the Lord's words

items.title: Jehoram of Judah
items.charge: Slaying all his brethren with the sword; walking in the way of the house of Ahab; making high places and compelling Judah to fornication

items.title: Jehoshaphat
items.charge: Seeking the Lord and walking in his commandments; sending Levites to teach the book of the law through all the cities of Judah; setting the battle in array with singers

items.title: Jehoshaphat's alliances
items.charge: Joining affinity with Ahab; going to Ramoth-gilead with him; joining with Ahaziah to make ships

items.title: Jehu
items.charge: Executing the house of Ahab, then keeping the calves of Jeroboam

items.title: Jeroboam son of Nebat
items.charge: Two golden calves; priests of the lowest of the people; a feast devised of his own heart

items.title: Jezebel and Naboth's vineyard
items.charge: Judicial murder to seize an inheritance

items.title: Joab
items.charge: Murder of Abner and Amasa in time of peace

items.title: Joash of Judah
items.charge: Forsaking the Lord after Jehoiada's death; stoning Zechariah in the temple court

items.title: Joel and Abiah, the sons of Samuel
items.charge: Turning aside after lucre, taking bribes, and perverting judgment in the seat of the judge

items.title: Josiah
items.charge: A tender heart at the reading of the book; turning to the Lord with all his heart, soul, and might, according to all the law of Moses

items.title: Josiah at Megiddo
items.charge: Going to battle against Necho without inquiring of the Lord

items.title: Jotham
items.charge: Preparing his ways before the Lord his God; not entering the temple as his father had

items.title: King Saul
items.charge: Unlawful sacrifice; sparing what was devoted; consulting a medium

items.title: King Solomon
items.charge: Multiplying foreign wives; building high places to their gods

items.title: Menahem king of Israel
items.charge: Ripping up the women with child at Tiphsah, and buying Assyria with money exacted from Israel

items.title: Mordecai and Esther
items.charge: Mordecai: bowing not to Haman. Esther: going in to the king against the law, after three days' fast: if I perish, I perish

items.title: Nebuchadnezzar
items.charge: Pride: is not this great Babylon, that I have built?

items.title: Pharaoh and Abimelech, who took Sarah
items.charge: Taking another man's wife into the king's house

items.title: Rehoboam
items.charge: Forsaking the counsel of the old men; forsaking the law of the Lord

items.title: Saul and Doeg at Nob
items.charge: Slaughter of the priests of the Lord on an informer's report

items.title: Saul's rash oath, and the people at the blood
items.charge: A rash oath that snared the army; the people eating flesh with the blood; the son who unknowingly broke the oath

items.title: Sheba son of Bichri
items.charge: Insurrection: we have no part in David

items.title: Shimei son of Gera
items.charge: Cursing the king and casting stones at him

items.title: Solomon at Gibeon
items.charge: Asking for an understanding heart to judge the people, and not for long life, riches, or the life of his enemies

items.title: The Amalekite who claimed to kill Saul
items.charge: Claiming to have slain the Lord's anointed

items.title: Tryphon
items.charge: Taking Jonathan the high priest by treachery under a covenant of friendship; slaying him and the young king Antiochus

items.title: Uzziah
items.charge: Entering the temple to burn incense, which belonged to the priests

items.title: Zedekiah
items.charge: Breaking his oath to Nebuchadnezzar; stiffening his neck against the Lord's word by Jeremiah

items.title: Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah, and the four hundred prophets
items.charge: Prophesying victory at Ramoth-gilead by a lying spirit; smiting Micaiah on the cheek

items.title: Zimri
items.charge: Conspiring against his master Elah as he drank himself drunk; slaying all the house of Baasha
